name: Shek Kingdom
description: The homeland of the Shek: a sparse, tribal kingdom in the Stenn Desert, ruled by Queen Esata the Stone Golem from Admag. The legendary warrior Kral united the warring tribes centuries ago, and the Shek have raided their neighbors ever since. Esata wants to keep her people from fighting themselves extinct against the Holy Nation, which divides her warriors. Shek call humans flatskins.
